K-Laser models are medical devices designed for Health Practitioners such as
- Podiatrists
- Physiotherapists
- Chiropractors
- Hand Therapists
- Pain Doctors
- General Practitioner (GP) doctors
- Dentists
- Nurses and Massage therapists

Typical clinical applications treated
- Sports Injuries and sport performance
- Acute Soft tissues trauma 
- Chronic joints diseases 
- Musculoskeletal conditions
- Wounds and ulcers
- Warts - toe fungus - ingrown toe nails
- Head and Neck pathologies (TMJ- sinusitis)
- Chronic pain conditions
